Runs on this machine vary more between days than the 15% the removed tests are worth, so no saving is shown. Two workers were not faster and added five flaky tests, so the suite stays on one worker.

verifyAll.note: UG2 recorded run against H1 recorded run; the unit saving is outweighed by the browser run's variation

successPredicate: Unit tests: met (-75% against 30%). Browser tests: not met on this measurement. The owner accepted H1 with the browser target missed on 2026-10-10 and asked for a later milestone to reorganise the browser suite (T1).
savingsOutsideThePredicate: An ordinary milestone close runs `verify` and the milestone's focused specs (`verify:e2e:focus`) instead of `verify:all`: from about 40 minutes to a few minutes plus the affected specs (03 §6).

CI runs once per push (no pull_request duplicate), cancels superseded runs, and skips the browser suite for a documentation-only push whose previous push run passed; the code-quality reviewer's replay of the last 150 first-parent commits found 52 documentation-only.
`verify:quick` before each commit: about 378 s to 206 s.
